title: FFT Invariant Declarations — v1.33
description: All structural invariants that must hold across any FFT-compliant implementation.

invariants.name: Triadic Completeness
invariants.statement: Every field instance MUST carry φ, V, and R simultaneously. No partial instantiation is valid.

invariants.name: Resonance Monotonicity
invariants.statement: Within a bounded drift window, R must not decrease across successive operator applications without an explicit Stabilization event.

invariants.name: Coherence Declaration
invariants.statement: coherence MUST be declared at session init before any operator executes. Undeclared coherence = invalid session.

invariants.name: Drift Bound Enforcement
invariants.statement: Drift is bounded: |drift| ≤ δ_max at all times. Any operator that would exceed δ_max MUST be deferred to a Stabilization pass.

invariants.name: Paradox Structural Encoding
invariants.statement: Paradox states are structural, not errors. They MUST be enumerated in fft.ai.paradox.enum.json and handled via the paradox resolver, not suppressed.

invariants.name: RTT Phase Consistency
invariants.statement: τ = dR/dφ must remain consistent across all RTT-bound modules. Phase inversion requires explicit Anti-Time declaration.

invariants.name: S-N-R Partition
invariants.statement: At any state snapshot, system modes partition cleanly into Silence ∪ Noise ∪ Resonance. Overlap is a drift violation.

invariants.name: Operator Idempotence under Silence
invariants.statement: Applying any operator to a Silence state S=0⁺ must leave S unchanged or transition to Resonance. It must never produce Noise alone.

invariants.name: DCO Scaffold Integrity
invariants.statement: All DCO operators 4D–9D must remain structurally independent. No higher DCO may depend on a lower DCO's internal state.

invariants.name: SET Decoupling at Quiet Phase
invariants.statement: During Quiet Substrate phase (S=0⁺, no gradients), SET fields must report as uncoupled. Premature coupling is a paradox=structural event.

invariants.name: Spine URL Binding
invariants.statement: Any module that references the Spine must resolve against the canonical Spine URL at runtime, not a cached copy.

invariants.name: Module Registry Completeness
invariants.statement: fft.ai.registry.json is the single source of truth for module counts. Active modules must equal total_registered. Deprecated modules must be present in the registry with status=deprecated and are excluded from compliance checks. INV-012 passes when active count matches registry.

invariants.name: QMROOT Ladder Closure
invariants.statement: Every FFT implementation must be traceable to a 0D Silence seed through the QMROOT ladder. Orphaned modules at 3D+ with no 0D ancestry are invalid. Absent rungs (currently 6D, neg_anc) are gaps — not violations — and must not be invented.
invariants.gap_policy: Absent rungs are marked absent in fft.ai.rtt.qmroot.json with an explicit absent_reason. INV-013 is satisfiable while gaps remain.
